card.name: Just before the word prostate
card.fires_on: The spot right before 'prostate' in prostate cancer phrases, such as the 'Pro' of 'Pro-state' after 'Hormone-Refractory' or 'Castration-Resistant', or 'of' in 'Carcinoma of the'. It also fires weakly on a few other words that precede a body-related term.

modes.label: Split word Pro|state
modes.description: The first piece 'Pro' of prostate after hormone-refractory or castration-resistant wording.

modes.label: Linking words before prostate
modes.description: Hyphens, 'of', or a bracket where 'prostate' or its abbreviation comes next.
modes.example: 2.5 Treatment of Advanced Androgen-Dependent Carcinoma<< of>> the Prostate (for Palliation Only
